answer.book: Joh. Henr. Heideggeri Historia Papatus (Amsterdam 1684), a history of the papacy in seven periods, each with a breviarium and numbered paragraphs, preceded by title, dedication, preface and epigram; a second work, Guicciardini's Historia Papatus, follows, then two indexes (chronological, and of things and persons).
